## Data Entry QC {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r libs, include = F}
library(plantcomNGPN)
library(tidyverse) # dplyr, purrr, tidyr
library(knitr) # for kable and include_graphic()
library(kableExtra) # for custom kable features
library(sf) # for checking plot coords against park bounding boxes
library(data.table) # faster summarizing than dplyr for big datasets
library(DT) # much faster at making tables for large dfs than kable

all_years <- params$all_years
year_curr <- params$year_curr
year_range <- if(all_years == TRUE){2011:year_curr} else {year_curr}
year_hist <- 2011:(year_curr - 1)
```

### QC Check Table {.tabset}
```{r qccheck}
QC_check_table
```

```{r taxa, eval = taxa_include, results = 'asis'}
cat("### Taxa Table {.tabset}", "\n\n")

check_null_print(dt_taxa_miss_sci, 4, "Blank SciName")

check_null_print(kbl_taxa_miss_sym, 4, "Blank Symbol")

check_null_print(dt_taxa_miss_tsn, 4, "Blank ITIS_TSN")

check_null_print(kbl_taxa_miss_nb, 4, "Blank NotBio")

cat("\n\n")
```

```{r pointint, eval = pint_include, results = 'asis'}
cat("### Point Intercept {.tabset}", "\n\n")

check_null_print(dt_num_ground, 4, "Missing Ground")

check_null_print(dt_ht_check, 4, "Missing Height")

check_null_print(kbl_dup_order, 4, "Duplicate Order")

check_null_print(kbl_ht_oor, 4, "Height over 2m")

check_null_print(kbl_point99, 4, "Heights over 99.8pct")

check_null_print(kbl_trans12, 4, "Odd Transects")

cat("\n\n")
```

```{r densb, eval = densb_include, results = 'asis'}
cat("### Quadrats {.tabset}", "\n\n")

check_null_print(kbl_dtrans12, 4, "Odd Transects")

check_null_print(kbl_dtrans1, 4, "Transects not = 1")

check_null_print(kbl_subfrac_imp, 4, "Subfrac Typo")

check_null_print(kbl_spp_count, 4, "Count != 1")

check_null_print(kbl_spp_dup2, 4, "Duplicate Spp.")

cat("\n\n")
```

```{r trees, eval = tree_include, results = 'asis'}
cat("### Trees and Poles {.tabset}", "\n\n")

check_null_print(dt_trees_wrong_drc, 4, "Wrong Diam - DRC")

check_null_print(dt_trees_wrong_dbh, 4, "Wrong Diam - DBH")

check_null_print(dt_bigt, 4, "Big Trees")

check_null_print(dt_trees99, 4, "DBH over 99pct")

check_null_print(dt_bigdrc, 4, "Big DRC")

check_null_print(kbl_trees_drc99, 4, "DRC over 99pct")

check_null_print(kbl_small_dbh, 4, "DBH under 2.54")

cat("\n\n")

if(nrow(bigt) > 0){
cat("#### Big Trees Diam. Distr", "\n\n")

hist(bigt$diam, main = "Distribution of DBH/DRC > 60cm", xlab = "DBH/DRC class")

cat("\n\n")
} 

check_null_print(dt_tree_miss_uv, 4, "Trees missing UV")

check_null_print(dt_tree_incon_UV1, 4, "Trees incon. UV1")

check_null_print(dt_tree_conds_UV2, 4, "Trees incon. UV2")

check_null_print(dt_pole_uv, 4, "Poles with UV")

check_null_print(kbl_tree_statcodes, 4, "Incons. Live Status Codes")

check_null_print(dt_dead_con, 4, "Incons. Dead UV2")

check_null_print(kbl_dead_miss_uv2, 4, "Dead missing UV2")

cat("\n\n")
```
